The Problem

Healthcare scheduling is broken.

The market has two types of tools:

Scheduling systems

Manage internal staff but hit a wall when shifts can't fill.

Staffing marketplaces

Supply external workers but have zero visibility into a facility's internal operations.

Nobody connects both sides. That's the gap we solve.

The Solution

One platform. One workflow. Fully connected staffing.

Staffy Workforce Scheduling is a closed-loop workforce management platform built specifically for healthcare facilities — including long-term care, retirement homes, hospitals, and homecare organizations.

How it works

A complete system that prioritizes your team, fills gaps automatically, and ensures every worker is qualified.

01

Internal Scheduling First

Facilities schedule their own staff first using a system that is CBA-compliant, credential-aware, and preference-based — built specifically for healthcare.

  • CBA-compliant scheduling
  • Credential-aware assignments
  • Preference-based shift allocation
  • One platform — not stitched-together tools
02

Automatic External Fill

When a shift doesn't fill internally, it automatically cascades to Staffy's marketplace of 20,000+ vetted healthcare workers.

  • No phone calls
  • No agency negotiations
  • No separate workflow
  • Automatic cascade to vetted workers
03

Real-Time Credential Verification

Every worker on every shift is credential-verified before assignment. If a credential expires or a background check is pending, the system automatically blocks the worker and assigns the next compliant professional.

  • Automated license checks
  • Background verification enforcement
  • Auto-block non-compliant workers
  • Compliance built into the scheduling engine

Use Case

Built for real healthcare operations

Long-Term Care Facility

1

Schedule internal staff first

The facility uses Staffy Workforce Scheduling to assign shifts to their existing workforce based on availability, credentials, and CBA rules.

2

Gaps cascade automatically

When coverage gaps remain, unfilled shifts automatically cascade to Staffy's marketplace of 20,000+ vetted external workers.

3

Every assignment is verified

Every worker — internal or external — is verified for compliance before the assignment is confirmed. No exceptions.
